traits.note: VicFlora's account of the genus, as quoted in search results (the page itself was not read): heads of tubular florets only; involucral bracts in several rows, unequal, overlapping, each ending in a spine; receptacle flat to convex, with bristle-like scales; pappus of several rows of plumose bristles joined in a ring at the base, falling as one.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Cirsium (p. 514): leaves alternate, generally spiny-lobed or divided.

traits.woodiness.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Cirsium (p. 514): annual, biennial or perennial herbs.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Cirsium (p. 514): leaves generally spiny-lobed or spiny-divided.
